name: Product Sourcing & Planning
description: Supports e-commerce product managers with competitive intelligence on competing products, evaluates potential supplier partnerships, and produces a sourcing decision memo.

input_parameters.label: Product Category
input_parameters.placeholder: e.g., Running shoes, B2B SaaS analytics tools, Organic skincare

input_parameters.label: Target Customer Segment
input_parameters.placeholder: e.g., Professional runners aged 25-40, CFOs at mid-market firms

input_parameters.label: Sourcing / Planning Question
input_parameters.placeholder: What specific sourcing decision or product planning question do you need to answer?

steps.label: Competitive Product Intelligence
steps.description: ANTON compiles competitive intelligence on leading products and competitors in the category.

steps.label: Supplier Partnership Evaluation
steps.description: ANTON evaluates potential supplier or brand partnerships relevant to the sourcing decision.

config.promptTemplate:
Based on the competitive intelligence:
{{step-0.output}}

Evaluate sourcing and supplier partnership options for {{product_category}} targeting {{target_segment}}.

Assess: build vs. buy vs. partner options, key supplier types in this category, evaluation criteria for supplier selection, typical commercial terms, key risks in supplier relationships, and recommended sourcing strategy.

steps.label: Product Manager Review
steps.description: Review the analysis and add your specific supplier candidates or constraints.

config.checkpointMessage: Review the competitive intelligence and partnership evaluation. Add specific suppliers you are considering, budget constraints, timeline requirements, or other factors.

inputFields.label: Specific suppliers or partners to evaluate
inputFields.placeholder: List any specific suppliers or partners you want to include in the final recommendation...

inputFields.label: Budget, timeline, or other constraints
inputFields.placeholder: Budget range, required timeline, minimum order quantities, geographic constraints, etc.

inputFields.label: Decision needed from this analysis
inputFields.placeholder: What specific decision will this analysis inform?
